title: German Green Steel & Power IPO Details
intro:
German Green Steel IPO is a book build issue of ₹303.90 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 2.09 crore shares aggregating to ₹290.00 crores and offer for sale of 10.00 lakh shares aggregating to ₹13.90 crores.

German Green Steel IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 25, 2026 and will close on Sep 29, 2026. The allotment for the German Green Steel IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 30, 2026. German Green Steel IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 5, 2026.

German Green Steel IPO is set issue price band at ₹132 to ₹139 per share. The lot size for an application is 107 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,873 (107 shares) (based on upper price).

Systematix Corporate Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to German Green Steel IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2008, German Green Steel and Power Limited is an iron and steel manufacturer primarily operating in the western region of India, with a strong presence in Gujarat and a focus on TMX Bars. The company is predominantly conducted on a business-to-business basis with three (3) major types of customers, namely (i) distributors, (ii) dealers and (iii) institutional customers. The brand “German TMT” has established strong recognition for TMT Bars in Gujarat.

The company's manufacturing capabilities ranging from 8 mm to 40 mm. The corporate and registered office is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and the Samakhiyali Facility is situated close to ports in Gujarat.

The company operates two manufacturing facilities in Gujarat: the Samakhiyali Facility, which is vertically integrated, and the Viramgam Facility, operated through its material subsidiary, German TMX Private Limited. They are currently in the process of expanding the installed capacity of Sponge Iron at their Samakhiyali Facility from 66,000 MTPA to approximately 1,48,500 MTPA, MS billets production capacity from 2,14,500 TPA to 4,12,500 TPA and existing installed TMT Bars production capacity at the Samakhiyali Facility from 181,500 MTPA to 346,500 MTPA.

For the nine months ended December 31, 2024, the majority of sales were generated through a network of distributors and dealers. Business operations are predominantly conducted on a business-to-business basis, catering to three primary customer segments: distributors, dealers, and institutional customers. These intermediaries supply products to builders and contractors.
As of March 31, 2026, the company's workforce comprised 1,357 employees, and they utilised the services of 143 contract labourers.
strengths: Vertically integrated manufacturing setup, including captive power capacity
Extensive distribution network in Gujarat with long-term customer relationships
Experienced promoters supported by a strong management and execution team
Strong brand recall driven by quality products
Track record of growth in financial performance

faqs.question: How to apply in German Green Steel IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in German Green Steel IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in German Green Steel IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in German Green Steel IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' German Green Steel IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for German Green Steel IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in German Green Steel IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for German Green Steel IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 1, 2026 . Check the German Green Steel IPO allotment status .
